summary: The controller's application metrics Service is scrapeable by PrometheusDeploy's existing kubernetes-service-endpoints job. The controller exports SyncError conditions, and https://argocd is an allowed login URL while url stays argocd.home. Upstream v3.5.1 and 22 gate mutations support all of it. Only two advisory inaccuracies in the done-record remain.

findings.summary: Done-record says SyncError is set only after retries are spent; v3.5.1 also sets it from the prune guard and on a failed SetAppOperation
Done-record says the architecture artifact is unchanged; the generated artifact gains the metrics Service's interface and relation
